term: local coverage, contrastive discrimination, obtaining, and discovery
resolution: LocallyExplained and ExplanationSound use existing world-local token semantics. Discriminates adds a cross-world entailment test for complete supplied presence extensions; neither causal coverage nor a necessary token supplies it. The internal candidate passes that test because its contingent bearer occurs only in the selected history; why this bearer obtains remains open, as does adequacy beyond entailment. The empty discovery predicate models absence of discovered reasons while a reason still exists. No-existing-reason is not inferred. Bool worlds are modal indices, Nat times and predecessor indices are separate; no external explanatory bearer, totality formation, PSR or necessitation principle is assumed.
